sources.title: TabRank: Chain-of-Thought Distillation for Table Re-Rankers
sources.snippet: Our approach significantly improves performance across a variety of table retrieval datasets, increasing Acc@10 by 30.5% on HybridQA, 15.2% on SQA, 52.9% on TabFact, and 13.1% on TATQA subsets of the Multi-Table QA Benchmark compared to the base model. Notably, TabRank generalizes effectively to multi-table reasoning. Our code, data and models are available at github.com/AdarshSingh7647/TabRanker ††footnotetext: *These authors contributed equally to this work.
